modelLoadPolicy: one load shared by all four invocations; EXCLUDED from per-invocation latency
peakMemoryMetric: ru_maxrss of the probe process (whole-process high-water mark, not per-invocation delta)
interpretation: Measured on a GitHub-hosted native linux/amd64 runner with 2 CPUs and a 6 GB limit, single-threaded torch. Diagnostic only: establishes nothing about production latency or Render resource suitability.
